parameters.query:
SELECT 
    trip_id,
    url,
    trip_name,
    sku,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    category,
    type_of_slt,
    destination  
FROM
    all_trips
WHERE 
    (
        CAST(start_date AS DATE) > CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '60 days'
        AND start_date > '2025-10-01'
        AND category = 'University'
    )
ORDER BY 
    start_date ASC;
